ideas.pitch: An AI-powered intake and matching engine that ingests messy medical records, structures clinical data, and matches international patients with verified overseas hospitals and transparent cost estimates.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace - Patient journey covering discovery, case creation, record upload, AI provider matching, and quote comparison.
ideas.title: MediMatch AI: Cross-Border Case Creator & Provider Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core hackathon mandate of bridging fragmented international healthcare journeys with an automated AI document ingestion and matching workflow, mirroring winning full-stack health projects.

ideas.pitch: A side-by-side quote comparison and travel planning dashboard that breaks down foreign hospital procedure fees, accommodation, and post-op care into unified, verifiable patient estimates.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace - Quote comparison, selection, booking, and treatment planning across borders.
ideas.title: ClearQuote: Transparent International Medical Cost & Treatment Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in medical tourism marketplaces look for financial transparency and trust engines; this solves the anxiety of hidden international hospital costs.

ideas.pitch: A dedicated international provider-side dashboard featuring lead qualification, automated quote builders, and secure medical record sharing designed for overseas clinic administrators.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace - Provider side: lead inbox, case management, quote builder, appointment management and secure communication.
ideas.title: GlobalCare Provider Portal & Secure Lead Inbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Most teams only build the patient side; focusing heavily on the provider operations inbox proves a complete end-to-end marketplace ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: An AI triage and follow-up agent that coordinates post-treatment recovery milestones, translates clinical instructions into native patient languages, and flags complications during remote aftercare.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace - Virtual consultation, treatment, aftercare, review, referral, and AI-supported reminders.
ideas.title: MedTravel Assistant: Multilingual Triage & Aftercare Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the high-risk aftercare and language barrier phase of medical tourism, featuring clinical-grade multilingual AI triage that appeals strongly to health-tech judges.

ideas.pitch: A secure patient vault that uses AI to parse, sanitize, and translate scattered PDF medical histories into standardized international clinical summaries acceptable to foreign specialists.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace - AI layer: document organization, qualification, provider matching, quote comparison and reminders.
ideas.title: DocuMed: Secure Cross-Border Health Records & AI Document Organizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the painful real-world hurdle of incompatible medical file formats across international borders with a robust, demonstrable file-parsing pipeline.
